Name: Investment Maximized
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
[center][color=#93c47d][size=5]﻿Introduction[/size][/color][/center]Anyone can play this game and get money by farming your land, fishing and mining.  But if you want to be rich, you can invest in stock markets and pull in major gains!  This is a complete re-write of the old Investment mod.  I am far more experienced and decided it needed a big redo.

[center][color=#6aa84f][size=5]Mod Features

[/size][/color][/center][list=1]
[*]A functional UI to buy and sell stocks on the fly.
[*]Configurable menu key (Default is K)
[*]Seven different markets with different price ranges.
[*]Prices change from -5% to 10% (may change this for balance)
[*][b]1.1: [/b]Ferngill Bank has opened to you and is ready to receive your funds.  Add money to your account and you will earn interest on the amount on the 1st of each season.
[*][b]1.1:[/b] Desperate for gold?  Ferngill Bank will be happy to give you a loan.(50,000g Limit).  If you do borrow money, your account will go negative and Ferngill Bank will take 5% of your gold every 1st of the season until the debt is paid. 
[*][b]1.5:[/b] View your investment data by clicking on the mail icon.  It shows you how much you've invested in a stock, how much your stocks are worth that day, and how much profit you will gain if you sold all of that stock.
[/list]
Buy your stocks and each day the console will inform you of changes.. you do not need to use the console as you can Press it's menu key and see the differences yourself.  Determine whether it is smart to buy or sell each stock but don't take forever as prices can go beyond your ability.

[b]Attention!: For those who are upgrading to version 1.2.0, You need to move your InvestmentData Folder to the Mod folder within Mods.  From this day forward, the Investment Data will be saved within the mod itself.  [/b]

[/size][/color][/center]If you need help with any of my mods, or want to just hang out please visit my [url=https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf]Cozy Apartment![/url] You can get help by me or by one of the others who go there.!!

If you like to support me you can [url=https://www.patreon.com/MissCoriel]become a patreon[/url].  All of my Mods are Free and Open and will not be behind paywalls.. this is completely optional and very appreciated.
